description: This file defines the ClientResolver class responsible for resolving and constructing AWS SDK clients by processing various configuration options and dependencies.

classes.name: Aws\ClientResolver
classes.description: A class responsible for resolving AWS SDK client configurations based on provided parameters, defaults, and environment settings. It includes methods to validate, apply, and assemble configuration options necessary for creating SDK clients.

methods.name: getDefaultArguments
methods.description: Returns an array of default client arguments, including type, validation rules, default values, and documentation for each configuration option.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ClientResolver with a set of argument definitions specifying configuration options.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves and validates client configuration options, applying defaults and processing dependencies, and prepares handler lists for SDK clients.

methods.name: getArgMessage
methods.description: Generates descriptive error messages for invalid or missing arguments during configuration resolution.

methods.name: invalidType
methods.description: Throws an exception when a configuration value does not match the expected type.

methods.name: throwRequired
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating required configuration options are missing.

methods.name: _apply_retries
methods.description: Configures retry behavior for the client, including setting up middleware depending on the retry mode.

methods.name: _apply_defaults
methods.description: Applies default configuration values for certain parameters like retries and timeouts based on the provided configuration provider.

methods.name: _apply_disable_request_compression
methods.description: Sets the disable_request_compression configuration based on the provided boolean or callback.

methods.name: _apply_min_compression_size
methods.description: Sets the minimum size for requests to be compressed, validating the input.

methods.name: _default_min_compression_size
methods.description: Provides the default value for request compression size threshold.

methods.name: _apply_credentials
methods.description: Sets up credentials for the client from various input types including credentials interface, array, provider, or disables credentials.

methods.name: _default_credential_provider
methods.description: Returns the default credentials provider.

methods.name: _apply_token
methods.description: Configures token for request signing from different input types.

methods.name: _default_token_provider
methods.description: Provides the default token provider.

methods.name: _apply_csm
methods.description: Configures Client-Side Monitoring middleware if enabled.

methods.name: _apply_api_provider
methods.description: Sets up the service API provider and associated parsers.

methods.name: _apply_endpoint_provider
methods.description: Sets the endpoint provider, resolving endpoints based on service and region.

methods.name: _apply_endpoint_discovery
methods.description: Configures endpoint discovery options.

methods.name: _default_endpoint_discovery_provider
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint discovery provider.

methods.name: _apply_use_fips_endpoint
methods.description: Configures use of FIPS endpoints.

methods.name: _default_use_fips_endpoint
methods.description: Provides the default FIPS endpoint provider.

methods.name: _apply_use_dual_stack_endpoint
methods.description: Configures use of dual-stack endpoints.

methods.name: _default_use_dual_stack_endpoint
methods.description: Provides the default dual-stack endpoint provider.

methods.name: _apply_serializer
methods.description: Prepares the request serializer middleware.

methods.name: _apply_debug
methods.description: Adds debug middleware based on configuration.

methods.name: _apply_stats
methods.description: Configures and adds request statistics collection middleware.

methods.name: _apply_profile
methods.description: Configures credentials profile loading.

methods.name: _apply_validate
methods.description: Adds request validation middleware if enabled.

methods.name: _apply_handler
methods.description: Sets the HTTP handler for the client.

methods.name: _default_handler
methods.description: Provides a default HTTP handler implementation.

methods.name: _apply_http_handler
methods.description: Wraps a custom HTTP handler into middleware.

methods.name: _apply_app_id
methods.description: Sets an application ID for user agent identification.

methods.name: _default_app_id
methods.description: Provides the default app ID from configuration.

methods.name: _apply_user_agent
methods.description: Adds custom user agent strings to requests.

methods.name: _apply_endpoint
methods.description: Overrides the endpoint URL for client requests.

methods.name: _apply_idempotency_auto_fill
methods.description: Configures automatic IDempotency token insertion.

methods.name: _default_account_id_endpoint_mode
methods.description: Provides default account ID endpoint mode setting.

methods.name: _apply_account_id_endpoint_mode
methods.description: Validates and sets the account ID endpoint mode.

methods.name: _default_endpoint_provider
methods.description: Returns the default endpoint provider based on service and region.

methods.name: _default_serializer
methods.description: Creates a default request serializer.

methods.name: _default_signature_provider
methods.description: Returns the default signature provider.

methods.name: _default_auth_scheme_resolver
methods.description: Creates a default authentication scheme resolver.

methods.name: _default_signature_version
methods.description: Resolves the signature version to use.

methods.name: _default_signing_name
methods.description: Resolves the signing name for request signing.

methods.name: _default_signing_region
methods.description: Resolves the signing region for request signing.

methods.name: _apply_ignore_configured_endpoint_urls
methods.description: Determines whether to ignore configured endpoint URLs.

methods.name: _apply_suppress_php_deprecation_warning
methods.description: Handles PHP deprecation warning suppression.

methods.name: _default_endpoint
methods.description: Resolves the default endpoint URL based on service, region, environment, and configuration.

methods.name: _apply_sigv4a_signing_region_set
methods.description: Sets the regions supported by SigV4a signing.

methods.name: _apply_region
methods.description: Validates and sets the region parameter.

methods.name: _missing_region
methods.description: Throws an exception when region is missing for a service that requires it.

methods.name: _resolve_from_env_ini
methods.description: Resolves configuration values from environment variables or INI files.

methods.name: getEndpointProviderOptions
methods.description: Extracts relevant options for the endpoint provider.

methods.name: isValidRegion
methods.description: Validates if a region string is a valid host label.

methods.name: _apply_client_context_params
methods.description: Applies client-specific context parameters defined by the API.

methods.name: isValidService
methods.description: Checks if a service name is valid according to the manifest.

methods.name: isValidApiVersion
methods.description: Checks if an API version directory exists for a given service.

methods.name: emitDeprecationWarning
methods.description: Emits a PHP deprecation warning related to PHP version support.
